_comment: Curated library-equivalence knowledge base for `rvo assess` (cross-framework migration readiness). Each entry maps an npm package to its per-target-framework status. Statuses: native (framework-agnostic, moves as-is), binding (official target-framework binding exists), replace (use the named alternative), blocked (no equivalent — migration blocker), unknown (not in this KB). Lookup falls back from exact package name to scope root (e.g. @nivo/bar -> @nivo).
